entry.author: Inland Revenue NZ
entry.summary:
The Momo Whakahaere kauhau (presentations) are an introduction to taxes for whānau Māori trusts. Part 2 explores the Māori Authority Account (MACA), making distributions to your members and how to record these.

More information:
Watch Momo Whakahaere Part 1 to recap: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hliw4XV8iQs

Find out more about Māori Authority credit account (MACA):
https://www.ird.govt.nz/income-tax/income-tax-for-businesses-and-organisations/income-tax-for-maori-authorities/maori-authority-credit-accounts-maca

Learn more about how we can help you and your whānau:
https://www.ird.govt.nz/maori

Ask for guidance from your local Kaitakawaenga Māori:
https://www.ird.govt.nz/contactus/kaitakawaenga-maori
